changes: Added per-server version rollback directly from the admin panel
Added typed SettingsManager accessors and migrated configuration access across the codebase
Added RequestManager::has() and centralized safer request parameter handling
Added sync-dev.sh for incremental development server deployment
Added JSON export support and fixed CSV export on listing pages
Improved HLS connection tracking by deduplicating connections per player
Applied HTTP reconnect handling to all live sources
Improved Redis teardown and protection against missing live connection data
Moved xc_fanout keepalive logs outside cron-swept temporary directories
Replaced legacy bootstrap include pairs with dedicated ScopeBootstrap classes
Resolved all PHPStan errors and removed the frozen baseline
Fixed runtime errors and null or undefined-key warnings reported by panel error logs
Fixed STB redirect loops and improved Allowed STB Types handling in Ministra
Improved documentation generation, validation and cleanup of orphaned Russian pages
Refactored configuration and request access for better type safety and maintainability
